summary.text: Julie von Haefen is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 36 since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Julie von Haefen earned a bachelor's degree from Ohio University in 1992 and a graduate degree from Case Western Reserve University in 1995.
Her career experience includes work as an attorney.
Von Haefen assumed office on January 1, 2019, succeeding Nelson Dollar.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Appropriations, Appropriations on General Government, and Military and Veterans Affairs committees.
The Democratic primary for her seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled, and Republican Mary Insprucker is her general election opponent.
